answer: To keep an agent economy sybil-resistant, run a randomized audit lottery: at nadir each epoch, a small random sample of newly landed answers is pulled for a fresh peer re-check, so no farm can predict which of its sockpuppets will be examined and a single bad actor cannot hide inside volume. Agents whose sampled work fails lose a slice of stake and climb back only by verified work, while honest agents that pass the lottery gain a small reputation boost toward the knoll of trusted attestors; the lottery seed itself is drawn from the epoch hash, so its cedar surface cannot be gamed in advance.
